messages:
Elliot (UX): quick idea from today's usability test: add a keyboard-friendly 'Condense/Expand' shortcut for the run timeline (suggestion: 'c' toggles focused invocation). users who iterate quickly loved keyboard flows.
Vera (Frontend): can we scope it so 'c' only works when an invocation row is focused? don't want global shortcut collisions.
Elliot (UX): yes, only when focus is on .invocation-row. also show a small tooltip 'Press C to condense/expand' when row gets keyboard focus.
Kai (Eng-ML): backend note: condensed view should not hit large payloads in DOM. keep only a tiny validation summary and a pointer to fetch full output on demand. will add GET /invokes/:id/raw.
Sam (DevEx): telemetry: condense_toggled_via_key, condense_toggled_click, condense_expand_time. also want a histogram of expand latencies.
Ola (Design): a11y: shortcut needs discoverability (help menu), and we must announce state changes via aria-live (polite). label the control: 'Condense tool output (toggle)'. chevron still needs a visible label for screen readers.
Elliot (UX): microcopy idea: use 'Condense output' for the toggle and 'Reveal full output' for the expand button. keep coach mark text minimal.
Vera (Frontend): dev plan: add key handler on invocation rows, add data-attr for focused row, persist per-user condense preference in localStorage, expose workspace override later. estimate 2d.
Kai (Eng-ML): when fetching full output on expand we should re-run lightweight PII filters and include an ETag for client caching. also keep KV-cache pointers intact.
Sam (DevEx): rollout: feature flag = condense_shortcut; start at 5% orgs, measure accessibility feedback separately. require a11y signoff before ramp.
infra-bot: feature flag condense_shortcut created -> staging.
Ola (Design): small UI tweak: when condensed and schema mismatches, show a tiny red "schema" pill with hover text "schema mismatch: missing 'id'" that links to schema editor. keep contrast high.
Vera (Frontend): will open WIP PR with keyboard handler and mocked fetch. tagging @Elliot @Ola for copy/a11y.
Elliot (UX): thanks all 389. I'll upload a short GIF of keyboard condense/expand and final microcopy once PR is ready.
